approvers: My adviser/tax consultant, house bank, spouse; staff informed
reason: The staff and name guarantees are what I would want to hear, and a free first meeting costs me nothing, so I will listen. But I have never heard of Always Broke Ltd, they have bought nothing before, and this is my life's work.
objection: A newcomer with no earlier sellers to ask, and a name like 'Always Broke'. How do I know they will still be around and keep their word to my people in two years?
instead: Keep running the business and wait for a successor, a staff or family handover, or a known buyer through my adviser or nexxt-change.
would_change_my_mind: Meeting the directors in person, seeing the bank letter checked by my adviser, and a reference from someone who has dealt with them or a known name behind the company.
